title: Easy Minor Chord Songs with Am, Dm, and Em — Practice Guide from JustinGuitar
summary: JustinGuitar’s short guide centers on using the D minor chord (and related Am and Em variants) to practice a curated set of songs across genres. He highlights specific examples where Dm and Am carry the progression (notably Arctic Monkeys’ “505”), notes minor/blue-influenced passages (Ain’t No Sunshine, All Your Love), and calls out songs with other chords such as E major and E minor (Chocolate Jesus, A Girl Like You). The video emphasizes practical tips for chord changes, tempo control (slow practice for speed of changes in Fallin), and the importance of motivation by choosing songs you enjoy. It also points to supplementary resources on the website (song lists, Beginner Song Course app, play-along tracks) to support ongoing practice.
